name: card-globe-white
blurb: White background globe card with grid pattern overlay.
description: A card displaying a 3D globe on a white background with a radial grid pattern overlay. Layout is centered with max-width and padding. Suited for light-mode designs.
use_when: Light-themed landing pages needing a globe visual for global reach messaging.
avoid_when: Dark mode layouts — the white background will clash.
a11y: Globe is decorative. Ensure any accompanying text is properly marked up.
